description: Land Acquisition - Beragama, Mulatiyana D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a Minister's name and title, the primary focus is on land acquisition matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
